maria_cs: Creating a short kickoff checklist for customers: prefills, batching defaults, streaming fallback, and early renewal-risk signals. Posting for quick review.

jordan_se: paste it here so I can copy into the shared playbook.

maria_cs: done below. keep comments to short bullets please.

---KICKOFF CHECLIST (FOR CUSTOMER CALLS)---
1) Prefill & warm pools
  - Run 2 prefills per model variant (5-20 tokens) immediately after integration.
  - Dedicated: enable warm_pool; Hosted: run 2 warmup passes within first 30m.
  - Tag events: `onboard:prefill_v1` for telemetry.
2) Batching & concurrency
  - Start safe: concurrency <=2 per instance.
  - Interactive flows: micro-batches of 2-4 to keep latency low.
  - Ramp to target over 72 hours while watching p95.
3) Streaming fallback
  - If p95 >800ms or error spike, enable streaming fallback for the route.
  - Client header: `X-Redwood-Fallback: true` (opt-out supported).
  - Quick curl to test: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Redwood-Fallback: true\" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":12}'`
4) Renewal & health signals
  - Track: `prefill_success_rate`, `avg_first_response_ms`, `failed_requests_1h`.
  - If prefill_success_rate <85% after 4 attempts -> tag `onboard:at-risk` and notify CS.
5) Ops notes
  - For Dedicated warmup, add `warmup:unbilled=true` telemetry tag for finance.
  - SRE: consider auto-rollback to quantized model after 3 spool-up failures to avoid warm pool starvation.
6) Quick repro template to ask customers
  - Env: Node 18 / redwood-sdk@x.y.z / Chrome 116
  - Prompt + max_tokens, region, any proxy/CDN in front
  - Sample response expectations and error logs (if any)
---END---

sophia_support: add PII reminder: mask emails/SSNs in any prefill logs.

lee_sre: agree on rollback note. also recommend a 30-min SRE/ENG tune session if tagged `onboard:at-risk`.
